text:
**Short answer:** for a MacBook Pro, get a bank with at least 100W USB-C output. If you have a 16-inch model, or want to charge at full speed while you work, get one with 140W (USB-C PD 3.1). Keep the capacity under 100Wh so it's allowed in a carry-on.

## Top picks

**Best overall: EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K (300W)**
- Macworld describes it as 99.54Wh, with a built-in retractable USB-C cable and 140W output that can fast-charge a 16-inch MacBook Pro. Total output is 300W, and it recharges at up to 280W.
- It's priced at $219.99 in Macworld's review. Wired shows a discounted price on Amazon.
- The 99.54Wh capacity is right at the airline limit.
- Sources: [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html), [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)

**Also top-rated: Anker Prime Power Bank (26K, 300W)**
- Macworld picks it as best overall. It has 140W PD 3.1 output, 300W total output, and 250W input, but no built-in cable.
- Laptopbee also lists the Anker Prime 26K and the Anker 737 (140W, 24,000mAh, 86.4Wh) among its top picks.
- Sources: [Macworld roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html), [Laptopbee](https://www.laptopbee.com/best-power-banks-for-macbook-pro/)

**Best value at 140W: INIU Cougar P64 140W**
- Macworld calls it great value with full 140W PD 3.1 charging. The downsides are no built-in cable and low total output.
- Source: [Macworld roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html)

**Best budget 100W: Baseus Blade H1 (20,000mAh, 100W)**
- It's flat and travel-friendly, at about 74Wh, so it's carry-on legal. It has 2 USB-C and 2 USB-A ports, and a 100W cable is included.
- It's $89.99 at Baseus's US store (verified Oct 21, 2026). It comes with a 24-month warranty and a 7-day return window.
- Caveats: input is capped at 60W (about 1.5 hours to refill). Baseus doesn't publish how power splits across ports when several devices are charging. At 100W it will charge a 16-inch Pro more slowly than a 140W bank, especially under load.
- **[Buy the Baseus Blade H1](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-blade-h1-100w-20000mah)** (affiliate link; the seller earns a commission at no cost to you)

## Which should you choose?
- **16-inch MacBook Pro, or heavy workloads:** EcoFlow RAPID Pro or Anker Prime 26K, or the INIU Cougar P64 if you want to spend less.
- **14-inch MacBook Pro, lighter use, tighter budget:** Baseus Blade H1.
- **Flying:** all of these are under 100Wh, but the EcoFlow is right at the limit.

I don't have direct retailer links for the EcoFlow, Anker, or INIU models in these results. The Macworld and WIRED pages above include current "View Deal" buttons, so check prices there before buying.
